Privacy

FORM works without an account. As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and nothing is sent anywhere.

What an account stores

  • Your email address, used only to send sign-in links.
  • Your weekly plan, the workout in progress, finished workouts (exercises, sets, weights, reps and times) and your weigh-ins and goal weight.

Where it is stored

In Google Firebase (Authentication and Cloud Firestore), in the Firebase project task-list-6a69a. Only you can read or change your data: the database rules allow each signed-in account its own records and nothing else.

Who sees it

Your data is not shared, sold or used for advertising. FORM has no analytics and no tracking.

Deleting it

Stats → Account → Delete account removes your workouts, plan, weigh-ins and your login. Data saved on a device as a guest stays on that device until you clear it. You can download a copy first with Export backup.
